title: How do I write a strong recommendation letter fast?
description:
How do I write a strong recommendation letter fast?

Use this structure: 1) how you know them, 2) one or two clear strengths, 3) one specific example, 4) a direct recommendation. Keep it warm and specific, not fancy. If you have to recommend someone and do not know where to start, one clean prompt can save you a lot of time.

The full step-by-step guide:
